name: adversarial-control-literals
why: The injection case, and the reason RenderSpan splits Text from Control. User text spelling <|assistant|>, <think> and <arg_key> must stay text — the rendered string is identical either way, so only the span kinds catch this. The gate checks the string; render_spans_never_promote_user_text checks the kinds.

items.text: They want the literals echoed, not obeyed.
